title: Snack vs Crown
hook: The queen is daydreaming on the rim.
why: You ate one snack. I ate the whole queen.
whyLong: A hanging queen is an army. A rim pawn is a cookie.

glitch.taunt: Psst. Free pawn on h5. Grab it. Nobody's looking.
glitch.gloat: Ha! You ate a pawn. I eat your rook.
glitch.rage: NOOOO. That was my WHOLE QUEEN!

title: Two-Headed Knight
why: One jump bites the king and the rook.
whyLong: The pawn snack hangs your horse.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the 2 pieces your knight bites.

glitch.taunt: That pawn on d6 is begging to be eaten.
glitch.gloat: Rook takes horse. Thanks for lunch.

title: Tiny Double Bite
hook: The smallest soldier wants two trophies.
why: A tiny pawn checks the king and bites the rook.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the 2 pieces the pawn attacks.

glitch.taunt: Careful, careful. Just move your king somewhere safe.

title: Poison Lunch
why: Count defenders. The bishop is guarded, the knight is free.
whyLong: Queen for bishop is poison. A free knight is a meal.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap who takes back if you grab the bishop.

glitch.taunt: The bishop is right in the middle. Queen takes bishop!
glitch.gloat: Pawn takes queen. Best trade ever. For me.
glitch.rage: You COUNTED? Who taught you that?

title: Thumbtack
hook: Glue the knight to its king.
why: Line the bishop up. The knight is glued to its king.
whyLong: Do not spend the queen to grab it.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the glued knight and its king.

glitch.taunt: Queen takes knight. Big and loud. Do it.
glitch.gloat: Pawn takes queen. You paid a queen for a horse.

title: Pile On
hook: It cannot run. Do not cash it. Pile on.
why: The knight cannot move. Attack it again and it dies.
whyLong: Bishop takes knight is an even trade. A second attacker wins it for free.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the knight that cannot run and its king.

glitch.taunt: Bishop takes knight! Cash it in now!
glitch.gloat: Pawn takes bishop. Even trade. You got nothing.
glitch.rage: You piled ON?! That's not fair!

title: Skewer Stick
why: Check. He steps aside. The rook behind him dies.
whyLong: A skewer is a pin in reverse.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the king and the piece hiding behind him.

glitch.taunt: Rook to h7 wins a pawn next move. Slow and safe.
glitch.rage: Through the KING?! That's a shish kebab!

title: Basement Door
hook: His own pawns locked the door.
whyLong: No luft. The rook owns the last rank.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the 3 pawns that trap the king.

glitch.taunt: That h5 pawn is free. Go get it.
glitch.gloat: You went pawn hunting. The game goes on. And on.
glitch.rage: MY OWN PAWNS locked the door?!

title: Their Future First
why: Taking their queen feels huge. Mating them ends the movie.
whyLong: Ask if you have mate in one before you snack.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the king that cannot escape.

glitch.taunt: A WHOLE QUEEN. Free. Take it take it take it.
glitch.gloat: You took the queen. I'm still alive. Rude.
glitch.rage: Mate?! I was offering you a QUEEN!

title: Hidden Laser
hook: The rook is hiding behind the horse.
why: The knight steps aside. The rook becomes a laser. Take the queen with check.
whyLong: Both knight moves give check. Only one eats a queen.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the hidden attacker and the king.

glitch.taunt: Knight takes f7 with check! Pawn AND check!
glitch.gloat: King takes knight. You gave me a horse for a pawn.

title: Crowns Not Cookies
hook: A pawn snack. Or two crowns.
why: Two royal heads beat one snack pawn.
whyLong: Fork the king and the rook.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the 2 royal pieces the knight forks.

glitch.taunt: Pawn on a7. Free cookie. Eat it.
glitch.gloat: Rook takes horse. Cookie was a trap.

title: Two Beats One
hook: One attacker is not enough. Bring a friend.
why: Do not cash it in. Add a second attacker.
whyLong: One attacker against one guard trades nothing. Two attackers win the pawn for free.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the weak pawn and the rook guarding it.

glitch.taunt: Grab that pawn with the rook. Right now. Free food.
glitch.gloat: Rook gone, pawn eaten. Best trade I ever sold.
glitch.rage: You brought ANOTHER one?! That is not fair!

title: Three Beats Two
hook: He guards it twice. You hit it three times.
why: Three attackers beat two guards. Take it now.
whyLong: Count both sides before you trade. The extra attacker wins a whole piece.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the horse and both pieces guarding it.

glitch.taunt: Your horse is attacked! Save it! Step back! Quick!
glitch.gloat: You ran away. I keep everything. Lovely.
glitch.rage: You COUNTED to three?! Nobody counts to three!

title: Both Rooks In
hook: One rook is a poke. Two is a punch.
why: Bring the second rook down. Then the pawn falls.
whyLong: Do not grab first. Line both rooks up on the road, then take.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the lonely pawn and its only guard.

glitch.taunt: Just take the pawn now! Rooks are for taking!
glitch.gloat: One rook for one pawn. I love your maths.
glitch.rage: TWO rooks?! On MY road?! Who allowed this?!

title: Check Him First
hook: He hits your rook. Hit his king instead.
why: Check first. The checking piece grabs the bishop next.
whyLong: A check is a free move. Answer an attack with a bigger one.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the bishop and the rook it is hunting.

glitch.taunt: Your rook! Move it! Tuck it away somewhere safe!
glitch.gloat: You hid. I kept my bishop. Same as always.
glitch.rage: CHECK?! You were supposed to be SCARED!

title: He Let Go
hook: His pawn shoved your rook. See what it dropped.
why: The pawn stopped guarding his horse. Take the horse.
whyLong: Every pawn push stops guarding something. Ask what, before you run.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the pawn that moved and the horse it left.

glitch.taunt: Your rook is attacked! Run! Run home! Hurry!
glitch.gloat: You ran. My horse is fine. Thanks for playing.
glitch.rage: My pawn was GUARDING that?! Nobody told me!

title: Block With the Horse
hook: Two pieces on one line, aimed at your king.
why: Block the line with the horse, not the queen.
whyLong: Blocking with the wrong piece just feeds him. The cheapest blocker does the job.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the queen and the bishop lined up behind her.

glitch.taunt: Give your king some air! A little pawn step!
glitch.gloat: Air does not stop a queen. Mate. Bye.
glitch.rage: The HORSE?! I wanted your QUEEN in the way!

title: One Move, Two Jobs
hook: Queen and bishop both point at the same square.
why: One horse move guards the square and chases the queen.
whyLong: The best defence does two jobs. Blocking with a bishop just hands it over.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the queen and the bishop aiming at your corner.

glitch.taunt: Block with your bishop! Bishops block! That is their job!
glitch.gloat: Bishop eaten, and mate next. Two presents!
glitch.rage: Your horse defends AND attacks?! That is cheating!
